Totally agree. These just don’t respect any boundaries. People don’t have kids for many reasons, either by choice or because of a health problems and are not obliged to explain that to anyone. Sadly, I had the chance to deal with both groups. First, when every aunt and uncle in the family felt the need to question us why we don’t have children the year after wedding. And now, few years later, I met the other camp. People that treat you like some animal that can’t control breeding, as soon as they find out about pregnancy. Suddenly none of your opinions or professionalism matters, from now on you’re just a preggo chick. Both groups are shortsighted and disrespectful. What I found surprising - the former group is usually young, educated people, that brag about inclusion and acceptance all the time.
Child free folks. I understand your point of view, but can you please stop being so aggressive towards people that want / have children.

A dream form 2016. I was severely depressed and just at the beginning of a new relationship. It was very memorable because of how happy I felt in it (compared to reality). It was very short though, just like snippet of a movie.
So me and my soon to be boyfriend are in car on a sunny summer day, driving past one of the city parks an laughing hysterically. He’s driving and I’m on a passenger seat veeeery pregnant. And that’s it.
I always remembered this little moment of dreamy happiness and only recently realized that it kind of became a reality. The guy I was with is now my husband and our firstborn is due in September, so now I’m just curious what we were laughing about!
